name: fill_sign_add
description: Fill in a form that has no fields, as Acrobat's Fill & Sign does: type text (`text`, 10 pt), place a check, cross, dot or line, today's date, or a typed signature or initials (`text` drawn in a script font as filled outlines; at is its left edge, centred vertically), at `at` [x, y] in points from the top-left of the page (the text's top-left; a mark's centre). Creates movable, undoable annotations.

at.description: [x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.
